contract_bridge.actual_contract: upstream compiler of normalized copy; same verified C for all six arms and differential

cost_contract: Common raw-identifier gate for all arms; rejected input stays in denominator without equivalence decision. Six arms include pure-fragment AND canonicalization. Fresh process/Environment per admitted arm. Full schema/exact rows preserved. Original source-AST IC normalized on a copy; common base-only SAT and XOR(normalized upstream C, independent original-AST C) UNSAT audit precedes all six arms and per-query differential. Whole unsupported/unknown contracts stop without fallback. Common SAT/exact-row guard. Uniform remaining-budget policy. All failures and fallback costs retained.
fallback_policy: FrontendUnsupported -> no parser/solver/fallback; admitted Candidate or canonical Ineligible/normalization miss -> official with same audited normalized C; candidate unknown -> official with same audited normalized C only if >=500ms remains; exceptions or invalid witnesses are errors, not silently erased.
oracle_domain_policy: SAT replay requires common int64-domain audit; out-of-domain/errors retain witnesses and denominator and cannot count as success or a win.
correctness_requirement: Cost numbers alone do not establish equal guarantees. Per-query mapping validation/proof and replay checks must be assessed separately before comparative claims.
thread_observation: One computation child. Solver threads=1/parallel disabled; temporary mo-imports Python monitor threads recorded.
clock_boundary: 89s guard starts after initial stdlib time import; per-child supervisor wall includes spawn/startup through reap. Worker final checkpoint excludes final write, full process wall/CPU measured here.
